edibles.heading: Edibles
paragraphs: After Dark Cannabis sits on Jane Street in York, a short stretch from Weston and Mount Dennis, and the store stays open around the clock. If you live nearby or you are already on Jane after dark, this is the walk-in counter for packaged cannabis edibles rather than dried flower.

Edibles are cannabis products you eat or drink. They are sold in sealed retail packs with listed flavours, formats, and milligram amounts on the label. That is a different shopping path from flower, pre-rolls, or vapes: you are choosing a packaged item by name, pack size, and the details printed on the current menu, not by bud appearance.

The live menu is the only reliable list of what is on the shelf. Names, pack sizes, and posted prices move, so treat anything you saw last week as a starting point rather than a guarantee. If you need a particular pack, call 437-524-9344 before you make a special trip.

Walk in at 1664 Jane St whenever you are ready. No appointment is required. Staff can help you read pack details and compare listed items against what you came in for. Bring ID. You must be 19 or older to enter and to purchase.
Come in from Jane Street, Weston, or Mount Dennis and ask to see the edible section in person. The store is open 24 hours.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes
paragraphs: After Dark Cannabis is the 24-hour Jane Street shop in York, used by people coming from Weston, Mount Dennis, and the Jane corridor at any hour. THC vapes are the category to open if you want a portable, battery-powered format instead of flower or an edible pack.

A THC vape is a sealed cannabis vapour product. On this menu the category can include disposable units and 510-style cartridges; what is actually on the counter changes, so confirm formats on the live menu or in the store. Read each listing for brand, listed potency, flavour notes, and pack details rather than assuming one style will always be there.

Posted prices on the vape page can change. The live menu is the current reference. If you are coming specifically for a disposable or a 510-style item, call 437-524-9344 first so you are not guessing from an old screenshot.
Walk in at 1664 Jane St. The door is open 24 hours. Bring government-issued photo ID. Staff can pull the vape section and help you compare listed options without an appointment.

If you already know you want a disposable or a 510-style listing, say that at the counter so staff can point you to the labelled units that are actually out. If you are still choosing, stay with the live menu names and the pack details printed on each item.
Jane Street in York is the address. Come when it suits your schedule.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates
paragraphs: After Dark Cannabis is on Jane Street in York, open 24 hours for adults coming from Weston, Mount Dennis, and the surrounding Jane corridor. Concentrates are the extracted-cannabis section of the menu, separate from flower jars, edible packs, and vape hardware.

In plain terms, concentrates are cannabis extracts sold in small retail formats. Listings typically show the product name, extract style, listed potency, and pack weight. That is a different read than flower tiers. You are matching a labelled extract to what you want to buy that visit, not shopping by bud structure.
Only the live menu shows what is currently posted. Names and prices change. Do not treat an older list as stock. If one extract is the reason for the trip, call 437-524-9344 before you head over.
Walk in at 1664 Jane St any hour. No booking is needed. Bring ID; the store serves adults 19 and older. Ask for the concentrate counter and compare the labelled items in front of you.
If you are comparing more than one extract, use the listed name and pack weight rather than a nickname from another shop. Staff can help you compare those labels with the current After Dark menu.
York, Weston, and Mount Dennis shoppers can use Jane Street as the landmark and come in when they are ready.

vapes.heading: Nic Vapes
paragraphs: After Dark Cannabis is the Jane Street shop in York for adults coming from Weston and Mount Dennis at any hour. Nic vapes are the nicotine vapour listings on this counter, kept separate from the THC vape page.

A nic vape is a sealed nicotine vapour product. Listings usually show brand, flavour notes, and pack details. Hardware styles change with what is posted that day. Check the live menu for current formats instead of assuming a particular device will be in the case. This is not a cannabis extract and it is not a THC cartridge; read the label so you are in the right section.
Posted prices can change. The live menu is the current list. If one nic vape name is the reason you are coming down Jane Street, call 437-524-9344 before you leave.

Walk in at 1664 Jane St. The store is open 24 hours. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask for the nic vape section and compare the labelled units on the counter with the names you already checked.
If you also want a THC vape or flower, keep those on separate lists. Staff can move you from one labelled section to the next without an appointment.
Jane Street in York is the address. Come in when it suits you.
Check the current listing again before leaving Weston or Mount Dennis.

flowerTiers.heading: Flower Tiers
paragraphs: After Dark Cannabis stands on Jane Street in York, open 24 hours for people in Weston, Mount Dennis, and the Jane corridor. Flower tiers are how this store groups dried cannabis on the live menu, separate from edibles, vapes, and concentrates.

Dried flower is cannabis bud sold by listed name, weight, and posted price. Tiers on the menu are price-and-listing groups, not a promise about a particular jar. Open the tier pages, then compare the names and weights shown that day. Do not treat a tier label as a hold on stock.
Posted prices can change. If you are coming for one listed name in a tier, call 437-524-9344 first. The live menu is the working sheet; an older screenshot is not.
Walk in at 1664 Jane St any hour. No appointment. Bring valid photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Ask staff to open the tier you reviewed and match labelled jars to that page.
If you are still choosing a format, start with flower tiers and only then look at pre-rolls or another category. Jane Street is the landmark.
Bring the listed name, not a nickname from another York shop. After Dark’s tier pages are the pages that apply on this visit. Staff can read those listings with you at the counter.
Weston and Mount Dennis are the nearby names. 1664 Jane St is the door.
